Name: Jahdai
Summary: Named as the father of Regem, Jotham, Gesham, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:47: Named as the father of Regem, Jotham, Gesham, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jahdai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
